CREATE TABLE tenants (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

CREATE TABLE approvals (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	object_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	object_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	requester_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	approver_id VARCHAR(36), 
	decision_note TEXT, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	target_version INTEGER, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	decided_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE audit (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	action VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	object_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	details TEXT NOT NULL, 
	integrity_mac VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE business_services (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	criticality VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	recovery_time_hours INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	recovery_point_hours INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE controls (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE frameworks (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	revision VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, name, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE policies (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(60) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	body TEXT NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE risks (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	likelihood INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	impact INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, 
	password_hash TEXT NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	active INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	token_version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	saml_subject VARCHAR(512), 
	oidc_issuer VARCHAR(512), 
	oidc_subject VARCHAR(512), 
	mfa_secret TEXT, 
	mfa_pending TEXT, 
	mfa_last_counter INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, email), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE vendors (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	service VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	criticality VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE control_findings (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	control_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	severity VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	remediation TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(control_id) REFERENCES controls (id)
)

CREATE TABLE control_tests (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	control_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	result VARCHAR(25) NOT NULL, 
	procedure TEXT NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	tester_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tested_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(control_id) REFERENCES controls (id)
)

CREATE TABLE evidence (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	control_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	uri TEXT NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	submitted_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	submitted_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(control_id) REFERENCES controls (id)
)

CREATE TABLE loss_events (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	service_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	risk_id VARCHAR(36), 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	occurred_on VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	loss_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(service_id) REFERENCES business_services (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(risk_id) REFERENCES risks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE requirements (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	framework_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, framework_id, reference), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(framework_id) REFERENCES frameworks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE risk_assessments (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	risk_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	likelihood INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	impact INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rationale TEXT NOT NULL, 
	assessor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	assessed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(risk_id) REFERENCES risks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE risk_comments (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	risk_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	author_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	body TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(risk_id) REFERENCES risks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE risk_contacts (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	risk_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	notify INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, risk_id, email, role), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(risk_id) REFERENCES risks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE risk_links (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	relation VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, source_id, target_id, relation), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES risks (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_id) REFERENCES risks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE risk_treatments (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	risk_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	strategy VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	due_date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(risk_id) REFERENCES risks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE service_dependencies (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	service_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	vendor_id VARCHAR(36), 
	risk_id VARCHAR(36), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, service_id, vendor_id, risk_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(service_id) REFERENCES business_services (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vendor_id) REFERENCES vendors (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(risk_id) REFERENCES risks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE vendor_assessments (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	vendor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	assessed_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	security_score INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	privacy_score INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	resilience_score INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	findings TEXT NOT NULL, 
	assessed_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(vendor_id) REFERENCES vendors (id)
)

CREATE TABLE control_links (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	control_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	risk_id VARCHAR(36), 
	requirement_id VARCHAR(36), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(control_id) REFERENCES controls (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(risk_id) REFERENCES risks (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(requirement_id) REFERENCES requirements (id)
)

CREATE TABLE remediations (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	finding_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	due_date VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	closure_note TEXT, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(finding_id) REFERENCES control_findings (id)
)

CREATE TABLE evidence_blobs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	control_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	nonce BLOB NOT NULL, 
	ciphertext BLOB NOT NULL, 
	submitted_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	submitted_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(control_id) REFERENCES controls (id)
)

CREATE TABLE login_throttles (
	key_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	window_start BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (key_hash)
)

CREATE TABLE saml_replays (
	id VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE enterprise_records (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	owner VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	data TEXT NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE enterprise_relations (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	relation VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, source_id, target_id, relation), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES enterprise_records (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_id) REFERENCES enterprise_records (id)
)

CREATE TABLE workflow_runs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	definition_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	object_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	initiated_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	step_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	steps_snapshot TEXT NOT NULL, 
	started_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	finished_at DATETIME, target_state VARCHAR(40), consumed_at DATETIME, object_version INTEGER, object_digest VARCHAR(64), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(definition_id) REFERENCES enterprise_records (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(object_id) REFERENCES enterprise_records (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(initiated_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE workflow_decisions (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	step_index INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	decision VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	note TEXT NOT NULL, 
	at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES workflow_runs (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE workflow_notifications (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	recipient_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	event_key VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	message VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	read_at DATETIME, webhook_sent_at DATETIME, email_sent_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_workflow_notification_event UNIQUE (tenant_id, event_key, recipient_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(recipient_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(run_id) REFERENCES workflow_runs (id)
)

CREATE TABLE risk_mail (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	risk_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(320) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	subject VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	due_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	sent_at DATETIME, 
	delivered_at DATETIME, 
	read_at DATETIME, 
	receipt_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	provider_message_id VARCHAR(255), 
	last_error VARCHAR(100), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(risk_id) REFERENCES risks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE risk_reminders (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	risk_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	enabled INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	interval_days INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	next_due DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(risk_id) REFERENCES risks (id)
)

CREATE TABLE risk_mail_settings (
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	auto_email INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)

CREATE TABLE mail_runtime_settings (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	encrypted_payload TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE workflow_deliveries (
	notification_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	channel VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	next_attempt_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	lease_token VARCHAR(36), 
	last_error VARCHAR(100), 
	delivered_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (notification_id, channel), 
	FOREIGN KEY(notification_id, tenant_id) REFERENCES workflow_notifications (id, tenant_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workflow_delivery_channel CHECK (channel IN ('webhook','email')), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_workflow_delivery_attempts CHECK (attempts >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_oidc_identity ON users (tenant_id, oidc_issuer, oidc_subject)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_risk_reminders_tenant_risk ON risk_reminders (tenant_id, risk_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_workflow_notification_id_tenant ON workflow_notifications (id, tenant_id)
